Northside CNRA
The Northside area exhibits the standard grid pattern of streets, with five east/west collectors (Taylor and Julian are major) and fifteen north/south streets (Seventh, Tenth, Eleventh and Thirteenth all major collectors). Julian, Tenth and Eleventh Streets are all one-way, contributing to an easy flow of traffic. Bayshore Freeway (Route. 101) crosses the northeasterly tip of the neighborhood.

Transit Data
Bus route 85 serves the Northside area along 17th Street, providing linkage with downtown, Line 62 connecting Los Gatos and Berryessa travels Taylor Street, and line 81 on Julian Street, provides transit service to the East Valley.
